newsitem.title: USA: SCAN-OPTICS names James Mavel chairman.
newsitem.headline: SCAN-OPTICS names James Mavel chairman.

text.p: SCAN-OPTICS Inc said current chairman Richard Tanaka will hand over the reigns to chief executive James Mavel at the close of the company's annual meeting on May 15.
Mavel will hold the title of chairman, chief executive and president of the company following the meeting.

"The transfer of the position of chairman of the board to Jim Mavel is the last step of a process we began over a year ago. Jim is not only a very capable and competent manager, he is also a leader. He will help this company not only realize its potential, but establish imaging systems as a vital technology. I wish him great success in his new role," Tanaka said.
Mavel joined the company in January 1996. Tanaka has been chairman since 1989.
